item_name: Rothco G.I.Type Steel Toe Combat Boot
item_short_desc: Rothco GI Type Steel Toe Combat Boots provide all-day protection and comfort.
description: Rothco GI Type Steel Toe Combat Boots provide all-day protection and comfort. Constructed with a durable, top grain cowhide leather upper and steel toe for protection, the combat boots are ideal for military professionals. The classic military boots feature a steel shank and fully stitched soles for comfortable support, while the rubber outsole is oil resistant for long-lasting wear.
